scope: actor-visible current pressure and recovery presentation vocabulary

pressure_states.written_equivalent: Staffing and capacity constraint; visible fields require attention.
pressure_states.non_color_motion: Text label, hatch/double-line pattern, and static reduced-motion presentation.

pressure_states.written_equivalent: Demand pressure; the visible unmet-demand value is reported.
pressure_states.non_color_motion: Text label, wave-line pattern, and static reduced-motion presentation.

pressure_states.written_equivalent: Financial distress or operating loss; visible cash, runway, and result text remain available.
pressure_states.non_color_motion: Text label, diagonal-hatch pattern, and static reduced-motion presentation.

pressure_states.written_equivalent: Regulatory review; visible review text and current status remain explicit.
pressure_states.non_color_motion: Text label, dotted-frame pattern, and static reduced-motion presentation.

pressure_states.written_equivalent: Community-trust concern; visible trust status is reported.
pressure_states.non_color_motion: Text label, crosshatch pattern, and static reduced-motion presentation.

pressure_states.written_equivalent: Delayed project; visible timing and status are reported without a hidden cause.
pressure_states.non_color_motion: Text label, dashed-ring pattern, and static reduced-motion presentation.

pressure_states.written_equivalent: Uncertain or stale intelligence; missingness or revision remains explicit.
pressure_states.non_color_motion: Text label, dot-dash pattern, and static reduced-motion presentation.

pressure_states.written_equivalent: Operational recovery; the visible monthly result is reported without a guaranteed future outcome.
pressure_states.non_color_motion: Text label, ascending-mark pattern, and static reduced-motion presentation.

limits: The taxonomy registers current actor-visible categories only; no hidden severity, intent, probability, causality, or future outcome is inferred.
Event cues and music states are eligible visible-only channels, not proof of direct campaign-envelope audio mapping.
No new campaign-specific pressure ID, transition, asset, audio file, screenshot, placement, or registry entry is created or promoted.
Existing technical text, pattern, reduced-motion, accessibility, and provenance checks do not establish human quality, comprehension, or educational usability.
No instructor-only true-state view, counterfactual, distributional visualization, persistence, or public-release claim is made.
